source: Existing deterministic successive-update trajectory for seed 2002 outcomes 368-384, inspected before this protocol. No new probe outcome used for checkpoint selection.

checkpoint_selection.reason: Earlier positive-RPE update from zero pre-update upper-bound weights; existing frozen trajectory improved from 0 to 17 GOOD+. Applied 300-ms target-97-105 change has 30.179 mV L1 while near-cue bins also change.

First later positive-RPE, far-cue-dominant harmful update after the outcome-373 case in the saved short window; 331 upper-bound weights before update, 10 to 0 GOOD+, 18.254 mV applied to 300-ms targets 97-105 and no applied change to 150-ms or nearer bins.

fixed_structural_omission: At each checkpoint omit only the production-applied update on all 36 edges from 300-ms relay sources 48-51 to motor targets 97-105. Reconstruct IDs from the unchanged synthetic topology. Keep every other applied weight and every nonweight state identical to full. No update rescaling or clipping change.
frozen_probe: The exact existing A3 common 32-note panel at each checkpoint, with plasticity and exploration off. Prior real-full probes must reproduce A3 exactly. No probe result feeds training.
primary_endpoint: First motor on-threshold upward crossing in integer microseconds versus no update and real full, or explicitly absent. For outcome 377, a later crossing toward no update after the omission supports recurrence of the outcome-373 cohort mechanism. For outcome 372, report whether omission removes the beneficial full-update timing change; an opposite response would show state dependence. Do not force score or timing attribution if a branch is silent or changes action pattern.
secondary_endpoints: all DOWN actions and signed errors
clipped/applied per-bin update and pre-bound occupancy
scope_limit: Exactly two checkpoints and one fixed structural omission at each. No parameter search, learning-rule edit, other mask, extra training, or claim of held-out generalization.
